name: Form-Field Macro
summary: Form controls shot like macro product photography: a giant field shakes red with the fix suggested, and Pulse is a switch you flip on.
look: Soft studio-lit off-white with one enormous input, toggle or button in crisp focus and neighbouring fields blurred out of focus. Teal focus halos for attention, coral halo and shake for the anomaly, a caret as tall as a column.

components.name: Floating-label input
components.role: the metric as a giant field

components.name: Segmented control / giant button
components.role: the human's choice and the CTA

motion.name: Focus-ring morph
motion.how: box-shadow spread 0 to 14 px plus radius spring, 0.25 s on the kick

motion.name: Error shake
motion.how: 5 px, 3 cycles, 0.3 s, then helper text types in

motion.name: Macro dolly + rack focus
motion.how: camera glides between fields 1.2 s sine.inOut, neighbours blur 0 to 5 px, arrive on downbeats

story: Hook: a giant dashboard dropdown opens on '1 / 38' under '38 dashboards to check. Before lunch.' Reveal: a macro toggle slides on and the Acme Pulse lockup rises beneath it. Proof: the Checkout conversion field shows 2.80% −18%, shakes with a coral ring and the helper 'since 09:42 · after deploy #2231', and the human picks Roll back on a segmented control. CTA: lockup, 'You ship. Pulse watches.', and a giant coral Start free button with a spring focus ring.
adapt: Shoot the single most important field or setting of your product huge and show your agent as a switch being turned on.

fit.risk: can look like a UI-kit demo; the macro camera, shallow focus and lighting must carry it
